thread:
alex: prepping release-2026-03-23b for runtime-gateway v3.3.0. change: model-route v4 + LRU cache tweak. rolling with attenuation (regional pin-playbook).

deploy-bot: /deploy release-2026-03-23b runtime-gateway v3.3.0 - started by alex

alex: rollout plan:
- start ff.gateway.route_v4 at shadow (0%) during deploy
- ramp: 2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% (2m soak each)
- gates: p95 delta <= +140ms, errors <= +0.5% absolute
- regional drain if region breach >90s; full rollback if global errors > +0.9% for 60s

priya: I'll enable route heatmap alert and watch tail metrics. auto-escalation ON for first 20m after 60% step.

lee: pin old binary on na-west and eu pools for 1h post-promote so quick swap is available. running pin:
```
ssh infra@ops "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-gateway v3.2.9 --pools=na-west,eu"
```

alex: post-deploy set ff.gateway.route_v4=2%: `flags set ff.gateway.route_v4 2 --release=release-2026-03-23b`

priya: 2% soak: p95 +12ms, errors flat. cache priming logs show steady warmup.

lee: bumping to 15% now. `flags set ff.gateway.route_v4 15`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.gateway.route_v4 -> 15%

priya: 50s in at 15%  ap-east p95 spiked +230ms. region filter shows cold-starts on a subset of pods.

alex: decision: regional attenuation for ap-east. set region flag to 0% and keep global ramp elsewhere. @lee pin ap-east old route for 2h.

lee: running regional commands:
`flags set ff.gateway.route_v4 --region=ap-east 0`
```
ssh infra@ap "sudo runtimectl pin runtime-gateway v3.2.9 --pool=ap-east --ttl=2h"
```

deploy-bot: regional flag update: ap-east ff.gateway.route_v4 -> 0%

priya: after drain ap-east p95 returned to baseline; global metrics healthy. proceeding to 60% excluding ap-east.

alex: `flags set ff.gateway.route_v4 60 --exclude-region=ap-east`

deploy-bot: flag update: ff.gateway.route_v4 -> 60% (ap-east excluded)

lee: autoscaler did a small bump at 60% but no OOMs. infra will keep pins active for 2h for rollback options.

nina: release note blurb: "runtime-gateway v3.3.0 rolled out using attenuation flag ff.gateway.route_v4. ap-east retained previous version due to regional cache warmup; regional pin applied. No customer-facing errors."

priya: PD incident INC-2026-347 opened as minor; resolution: regional attenuation + pin, monitoring extended.

alex: wrap-up for GH release notes and runbook items:
- rollout style: attenuation (2->15->60->100) with regional pin fallback
- safety gates and thresholds
- playbook commands used for regional drain and pin/unpin
- action: add region-specific warmup step and route-tail heatmap alert

lee: unpin plan: `runtimectl unpin runtime-gateway --pool=ap-east` after warmup window tomorrow.

nina: I'll add FAQ to support docs explaining "attenuation" vs "canary" language.

alex: thanks team, marking thread to be closed after unpin. good coordination. :white_check_mark:
